searchText: That could work as well. The tricky part of it is Consensus API. Beacon chain client sends 256 block roots to the execution client so that the execution client is able to expose the in the EVM via `BEACONBLOCKROOTS` opcode. And enabling at least this tiny thing requires coordination on the both sides. Thanks for explaining that <@425572898787426305>
